question: Estimate the revenue impact of a 1% improvement in conversion rate for an Amazon India seller.
idealClarificationQuestions: Mid-tier Amazon seller doing ~₹50 Cr annual GMV? Yes.
Improvement from current ~5% PDP conversion to 6%? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Linear lift in revenue from conversion improvement.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Current state: traffic 1,000 PDP visits = 50 orders (5%) = ₹50K revenue (at AOV ₹1,000).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: After 1% absolute improvement to 6%: 60 orders out of 1,000 = ₹60K = +20% revenue.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: True revenue impact: ~₹12-15 Cr from a 1pp CR improvement.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: traffic 1,000 PDP visits = 50 orders (5%) = ₹50K revenue (at AOV ₹1,000).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus impact on Amazon search ranking (higher CR boosts visibility)
